title: COMSOL Programming Reference Manual
finding: A probe is created via model.probe().create(tag,type), then model.probe(tag).model(component_tag) assigns its model component. genResult takes a solver sequence tag and is required explicitly for API-driven solves. GlobalVariable is listed as a supported probe type on page182; its name does not establish component-free solver use.
local_api_check: ModelEntity javap confirms model() getter and model(String) setter. TableBaseFeature exposes column headers and real/imag matrices but no time getters.
copy_policy: Reference metadata and paraphrase only; no vendor documentation corpus or jar included.
